pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-brown regions with highly serrated, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck show higher edge angularity and larger relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more rounded patches on the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space separating the patches. Features clear tri-valent and tetra-valent junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck but increases in pixel width towards the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge, characterized by dense, vertically oriented hair bundles creating a serrated 1D contour.
